info.name: Vehicle Manufacturing Service - API Tests
info.description: End-to-end tests for every endpoint. Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner or newman). It first logs in to Keycloak as each test user (admin, planner, supervisor, viewer), checks the role rules, then runs the main flow as admin. It creates its own uniquely-named data on each run, so it can be repeated against the same database.
